basis: Stand-in sweep on the CPU delegate, Apple M4 Pro, Chromium 158, run label standin-cpu in results.json. 15 conditions: still (302 shown poses), roll +-5/10/15, dx +-160/320, dy +-60, zoom 0.75 and 1.15 (91 or 92 each), none gated. Measured: roll slope 1.006, gain x 0.995, gain y 1.037, rendered over face 1.059 at the still clip and 3.6 percent at most across zoom, gated share 0, bridge offset 0.064 of the interocular distance. Slopes and gains have truth 1 and get 10 percent; rendered over face, the zoom change and the bridge offset get about 2 times the measured value. The gated share is limited to 0.1, about one fully gated condition in 15, and each condition a metric uses must show at least 5 poses (a tenth of the 91 a clip yields, the rate of an emulated x86 container with 2 CPUs and SwiftShader). dy +-120 and zoom 1.33 are left out of the stand-in sweep because the solver gates them at most samples (reprojection RMS 5.8 to 6.3 mm against the 6 mm gate); the recordings sweep keeps them. Timing is not gated: runner hardware changes it without a code change.
